description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Ice, Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vivi (Ice/Lightning)], [Doomsday Icebolt Damage Tracker] and [Doomsday Icebolt Level]

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vivi (Ice/Lightning)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Doomsday Icebolt (0~2), removed after using Doomsday Icebolt two times

description.name: Doomsday Icebolt Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Doomsday Icebolt level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vivi (Ice/Lightning)]

description.name: Doomsday Icebolt Level
description.text: Keeps track of Doomsday Icebolt level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vivi (Ice/Lightning)]
